data.title: 黑歌 · 暮色缘侧的和服青烟微醺
data.description: 落日余晖洒满日式回廊，黑歌半倚缘侧立柱，黑底金纹宽松和服滑落半肩，指尖细长烟管吐出淡淡青烟。
data.action: 半倚木柱侧坐，手持长柄铜烟管轻吐薄雾，眼神迷离注视庭前落枫
data.lighting: 温暖如蜜的夕阳橙红光芒斜照，长长阴影与薄烟微光交织
data.camera: 中景侧平视，捕捉和服褶皱与侧颜轮廓
data.promptProse: Kuroka relaxes on the wooden engawa veranda of a traditional Japanese estate at dusk, gazing out over a peaceful garden of scarlet maples. Her loose black silk kimono patterned with golden ripples slips casually off one porcelain shoulder, revealing delicate lace beneath. Holding an ornate brass kiseru pipe to her lips, she exhales a thin spiral of pale smoke that drifts through the warm sunset air.
data.animaCaption: Sitting upon the twilight veranda with her kimono slipping off one shoulder, Kuroka gently exhales a wisp of pipe smoke.
